participant_count_scope: Minimum distinct identifiable live victim and compareciente speakers, including personal introductions, per supplied consolidated transcript. Attorneys are separate. Remote observers and people mentioned only as victims of an underlying crime are outside this speaker count. Repeated turns by one person within a transcript count once.

Generic role tags and diarization identifiers were corrected at named/announced floors; unresolved identities are merged or omitted. These are recorded speakers, not total audience attendance or underlying-crime victim totals.
